entries.title: Castation (Dreamcast)
entries.description: Dreamcast emulator (Homebrew Launcher build). The official ZIP contains Castation/eboot.elf, not an installable PS5 title; manually extract to /data/homebrew/ and launch through Homebrew Launcher. No ROMs included.

entries.title: Porpoise (GameCube / Wii)
entries.description: Native Dolphin-based GameCube and Wii emulator. Requires a jailbroken console and ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or later. Games not included.
